title: Brasswick Kettle Bridge - Lorepedia
description: The Brasswick Kettle Bridge is a cast-iron footbridge over the River Kettle in Brasswick, Northmarsh. It was opened in 1874 and is the oldest surviving iron bridge in the county. It was closed to traffic in 1931 and has carried pedestrians only since then.
author: Contributors to Lorepedia projects
